name: incident-triage
description: Front-line triage agent (reference peer in the registry, not deployed in this replica). Where Olly Sentinel does deep multi-source root-cause enrichment on declined events, this agent sits earlier in the flow: it reads a raw inbound alert, uses a fast LLM to summarise it in one line, assigns severity and an ITIL priority, and decides whether to auto-close, route to a runbook, or hand off to Olly for enrichment. Optimised for latency over depth, so it runs on a small fast model.

skills.name: Classify, score and route an alert
skills.description: Given a raw alert, use an LLM to produce a one-line summary, assign severity (1-5) and an ITIL priority, and return a routing decision: auto_close, runbook, or handoff_to_olly. This is a fast first pass, not a root-cause analysis; the deep RCA belongs to Olly Sentinel.

eems.description: EEMS bearer for role gco-sre-triage: read alerts plus route incidents.
